label: On startup
description: Choose what opens when Lithium starts.

label: Homepage URL
description: URL used by the Home button and optional homepage startup.

label: Open external links in a new tab
description: Open links that request a new window as a new Lithium tab.

label: Confirm when closing multiple tabs
description: Ask before closing the whole window when several tabs are open.

label: Enable reopen-closed-tab shortcut
description: Keep a short in-memory list for Ctrl+Shift+T.

label: Show quit confirmation
description: Ask before quitting Lithium.

label: Prefer HTTPS for typed domains
description: Typed domain names use HTTPS first.

label: Remember window size
description: Remember normal window size between launches.

label: Open new tabs in background
description: Keep the current tab active when creating a new tab.

label: Restore previous tabs on launch
description: Restore recent tab URLs when Lithium starts.

label: Close window when last tab closes
description: When disabled, closing the last tab opens the new-tab page.

label: Reopen previously closed window
description: Experimental session history; not in the first release.

label: Spell checking
description: Enable Chromium spell checking in webpages. Restart Lithium after changing this preference.

label: Browser UI language
description: Language for Lithium menus and settings.

label: Check for updates automatically
description: Automatic application updates are not configured in this source build.

label: Restore pinned tabs
description: Restore pinned tab metadata with the previous session.

label: Confirm external application links
description: Ask before opening mailto and other external application links.

label: Close tabs on exit
description: Do not persist open tabs for next launch.

label: Show quit action in app menu
description: Show the in-app application menu and quit action.

label: Default search engine
description: Choose the provider used for regular address-bar searches.

label: Custom search URL template
description: Used when Custom search URL is selected. Must contain {query}.

label: Enable !bang commands
description: Resolve shortcuts such as !yt TechnOGamerz locally.

label: Bang prefix
description: Prefix used to trigger shortcuts.

label: Show bang suggestions
description: Suggest matching local search shortcuts while typing.

label: Show address-bar suggestions
description: Show matching commands, bookmarks, and local history.

label: Use history in suggestions
description: Suggest pages in saved local browsing history.

label: Use bookmarks in suggestions
description: Suggest matching saved bookmarks.

label: Autocomplete common domain prefixes
description: Treat domain-like input as navigation rather than a search.

label: Open address-bar searches in a new tab
description: Search from the address bar in a fresh tab.

label: Keep search results in background
description: When searching in a new tab, keep the current tab selected.

label: Show active search provider
description: Show the selected provider in the address bar.

label: Maximum address suggestions
description: Maximum number of suggestions shown.

label: Remember search queries
description: Search URLs may appear in local history if history saving is enabled.

label: Hide search query suggestions by default
description: Remote suggestion providers are not integrated in this build, so typed text is never sent to a suggestion service. A granular suggestion-provider feature is planned.

label: Search normally for unknown bangs
description: Unknown bang-like input falls back to the default search provider.

label: Match bang commands regardless of case
description: Allow !YT and !yt to select the same command.

label: Select address-bar text on focus
description: Select the full URL when focusing the address bar.

label: Use a separate private-window search engine
description: Preference reserved for private sessions, which are planned.

label: Suggestion source
description: Choose local suggestions or disable address-bar suggestions entirely. No remote query suggestions are sent.

label: Submit address-bar searches with Enter
description: Enter-to-submit behavior is fixed to standard browser behavior in this build.

label: Custom bang alias
description: An optional command such as !l that searches the default search engine.

label: Theme
description: Choose Lithium’s interface theme.

label: Accent color
description: Accent used for selected controls and highlights.

label: Interface density
description: Choose compact or comfortable spacing.

label: Tab strip position
description: Choose where tabs appear.

label: Tab shape
description: Choose the tab outline.

label: Show bookmarks bar
description: Show saved bookmarks under the toolbar.

label: Show browser sidebar
description: Show a compact side panel while browsing.

label: Sidebar position
description: Choose sidebar edge.

label: Show Home button
description: Show a Home shortcut beside navigation controls.

label: Show Downloads button
description: Show the download manager shortcut.

label: Show Shield button
description: Show quick privacy controls.

label: Show Bookmark button
description: Show a bookmark toggle beside the address bar.

label: Show status bar
description: Show a slim status bar for current page state.

label: Show clock on new tab
description: Display the local time on the new-tab page.

label: Show new-tab search card
description: Show the central search box on the new-tab page.

label: Show quick links on new tab
description: Display a small grid of editable shortcuts.

label: New-tab layout
description: Choose the new-tab layout.

label: New-tab background
description: Choose a built-in background.

label: Custom wallpaper URL
description: Optional HTTPS wallpaper URL for the new-tab page.

label: Interface animations
description: Enable subtle transitions in the Lithium interface.

label: Translucent effects
description: Use soft translucent surfaces where supported.

label: Interface font
description: Choose the interface font.

label: Interface text size
description: Scale Lithium interface text.

label: Corner radius
description: Choose the rounding used by browser controls.

label: Show app menu button
description: Show the Lithium menu for settings and browser pages.

label: Show open tab count
description: Show tab count in the tab-strip footer.

label: High-contrast interface
description: Increase borders and contrast for UI elements.

label: Visible keyboard focus
description: Keep clear focus outlines for keyboard navigation.

label: Hide window title text
description: Use a compact titlebar without descriptive window text.

label: Show page loading indicator
description: Show loading state on the active tab.

label: Show URL protocol
description: Display https:// prefix in the address bar.

label: Toolbar layout
description: Choose toolbar arrangement.

label: Custom accent color
description: Override the selected accent preset with a custom six-digit hex color such as #8b5cf6.

label: Block known trackers
description: Block requests to a locally bundled list of known tracking domains.

label: Remove common tracking parameters
description: Remove common tracking query parameters from top-level URL input.

label: Block third-party cookies
description: Strip cookie request/response headers for cross-site requests where detectable.

label: Send Do Not Track header
description: Attach DNT: 1 to requests.

label: Send Global Privacy Control signal
description: Attach Sec-GPC: 1 to requests where supported.

label: Block script-created popups
description: Block unsolicited windows opened by webpages.

label: Allow website notification permissions
description: Grant notification permissions only when enabled here.

label: Allow camera permission requests
description: Allow camera permission requests globally.

label: Allow microphone permission requests
description: Allow microphone permission requests globally.

label: Allow location permission requests
description: Allow geolocation permission requests globally.

label: Allow clipboard read permission
description: Allow clipboard read permission requests globally.

label: Clear cookies on exit
description: Clear browser cookies when the app quits.

label: Clear cache on exit
description: Clear cached web resources when the app quits.

label: Clear site storage on exit
description: Clear local storage, IndexedDB, and other site data on exit.

label: Clear history on exit
description: Clear local browsing history when the app quits.

label: Save local browsing history
description: Store a local history list on this device.

label: Save download history
description: Store recent download metadata locally.

label: Block third-party web fonts
description: Block cross-site font requests.

label: Block webpage images
description: Block image requests globally.

label: Reduce cross-site referrer data
description: Trim referrer headers when crossing site boundaries.

label: Always use private browsing
description: Dedicated private-session mode is not yet implemented.

label: HTTPS-only navigation mode
description: Upgrade top-level HTTP navigations to HTTPS. Sites without HTTPS may not open.

label: Secure DNS / DNS-over-HTTPS
description: DoH provider configuration needs engine-level integration.

label: Advanced fingerprint resistance
description: Do not enable a fake protection switch; deep fingerprint mitigations are planned.

label: Safe browsing integration
description: Reputation-service integration is not configured.

label: Restrict WebRTC network exposure
description: Advanced WebRTC IP policy requires browser-runtime validation.

label: Block all third-party storage
description: Third-party storage partitioning is planned.

label: Clear saved form data on exit
description: Saved form-data management is planned.

label: Anonymous product telemetry
description: Lithium has no product-telemetry endpoint in this build. Enabling telemetry is not available.

label: Send crash reports
description: Crash-report uploads are not configured. Crash information remains local.

label: Confirm closing the active tab
description: Ask before closing an individual tab.

label: Middle-click closes a tab
description: Use middle mouse click to close a tab.

label: Show tab close buttons
description: Show close controls on tabs.

label: Show new-tab button
description: Show a button to add a new tab.

label: Show website indicators in tabs
description: Display a local letter/globe indicator on tabs.

label: Remember active tab
description: Restore the last selected tab when session restore is enabled.

label: Mute all browser tabs
description: Mute audio from all current and future web tabs.

label: Throttle background tabs
description: Allow Chromium to throttle background pages (restart may be required).

label: Restore scroll position
description: Per-page scroll restoration is handled by websites; browser restoration is planned.

label: Nested vertical tab tree
description: Nested tab trees are planned.

label: Automatically group related tabs
description: Automatic tab grouping is planned.

label: Show memory use in each tab
description: Per-tab memory reporting is planned.

label: Suspend inactive tabs
description: Automatic tab discarding needs additional validation.

label: Compact tab labels
description: Use smaller titles on narrow tabs.

label: Show link preview in status bar
description: Display hovered link destinations in the status bar.

label: Ask where to save each download
description: Show a Save As dialog for each new download.

label: Download folder path
description: Optional custom download folder; leave blank for system Downloads.

label: Show download completion messages
description: Show a desktop notification when a download finishes.

label: Open downloads page after starting a download
description: Automatically switch to the download manager for new downloads.

label: Maximum active downloads
description: Display preference for concurrent downloads. Chromium controls actual network concurrency.

label: Clear download list on exit
description: Delete saved download metadata at application exit.

label: Confirm executable downloads
description: Show an app warning before opening a downloaded executable.

label: Show download file sizes
description: Show file sizes in the download manager.

label: Pause downloads on battery
description: Battery-aware download suspension is planned.

label: Open downloads folder on completion
description: Open the destination folder automatically when a download completes.

label: Use system download notifications
description: Allow system notifications for download state.

label: Default page zoom
description: Default zoom percentage applied to new web tabs.

label: Hardware acceleration
description: Use Chromium hardware acceleration when available.

label: Smooth scrolling in Lithium UI
description: Enable smooth scrolling on Lithium-owned pages.

label: Reduce background activity
description: Reduce background work where supported by Chromium.

label: Let webpages lazy-load images
description: Image loading policy is currently controlled by Chromium and websites; a browser-level override is planned.

label: Preload popular pages
description: Automatic page preloading is intentionally not implemented because it can create extra network requests.

label: Show performance panel
description: Developer performance dashboard is planned.

label: Memory saver
description: Automatic sleeping tabs are planned.

label: Energy saver
description: Battery-aware throttling is planned.

label: GPU rasterization override
description: Manual GPU rasterization flags are not exposed in this release.

label: Parallel download optimization
description: Chromium owns download scheduling; explicit override is planned.

label: Reduce motion
description: Reduce transitions and animations in Lithium UI.

label: Larger interface text
description: Increase font sizes in Lithium interface controls.

label: Increase contrast
description: Strengthen boundaries and text contrast in the interface.

label: Emphasize keyboard focus
description: Make keyboard focus easier to see.

label: Show toolbar tooltips
description: Show labels when hovering browser buttons.

label: Announce page status
description: Expose page loading status to assistive technology.

label: Disable parallax effects
description: This release has no parallax animation system to control.

label: Use expanded tab labels
description: Use fuller accessibility labels on tabs.

label: Screen reader optimizations
description: Additional accessibility enhancements are planned.

label: Custom keyboard shortcuts
description: Shortcut remapping is planned.

label: Allow Developer Tools
description: Allow DevTools using Ctrl+Shift+I on web tabs.

label: Show process diagnostics
description: Show Electron/Chromium version and environment information.

label: Enable experimental browser features
description: Experimental flags are not exposed in this release.

label: Proxy configuration
description: Use the operating-system proxy settings or connect directly. Restart Lithium to apply changes.

label: Custom CSS for Lithium UI
description: User CSS injection is not enabled in this build.

label: Update channel
description: Select release update channel.

label: Export diagnostics bundle
description: Allow exporting a local diagnostics report.

label: Experimental UI options
description: Feature experiments are disabled by default.

label: Cloud sync
description: Lithium has no account or cloud-sync service in this build.

label: Browser extension management
description: Full extension-management UI is not provided by this Electron shell.

label: Certificate viewer shortcut
description: Custom certificate inspection UI is planned.

label: Custom protocol handlers
description: Registering Lithium as a handler for custom protocols is planned.

label: Remote debugging port
description: Remote debugging is disabled for security.

label: Update on metered network
description: Automatic updates are not configured.

label: Show reset-to-defaults action
description: Keep a visible action to restore default settings.

label: Block third-party media requests
description: Blocking embedded third-party media is planned.

label: Cookie exception manager
description: Per-site cookie exceptions UI is planned.

label: Site data manager
description: Advanced site-data management UI is planned.

label: Permission prompt behavior
description: Deny site permissions globally, or allow only permissions enabled by the individual global toggles below.

label: Clear data when private window closes
description: Private-window lifecycle is not implemented yet.

label: Scan downloaded files
description: No external file-scanning service is included.

label: Enable custom bang manager
description: Show the form for adding, removing, importing, and exporting personal search shortcuts.

label: Automatically update bang library
description: Bang updates are user-initiated to avoid unrequested network calls.

label: Show shortcut provider in suggestion
description: Display provider name for local shortcut suggestions.

label: Open bang results in external browser
description: Keep command navigation inside Lithium.

label: Allow custom search redirect templates
description: Permit validated HTTP(S) templates for custom engines.
